value.signature: async fn start (& self , context : & Context < '_ >) -> ControlStartResult

exception.justification: Justified: The private start decision inherits the enclosing byte execution span and returns its closed result through that entry.

review.body: { let run = context . data_unchecked :: < StartRun > () ; # [cfg (test)] run . inputs . count . fetch_add (1 , Ordering :: AcqRel) ; let edition_supported = run . inputs . selected_edition == run . edition ; # [cfg (test)] let edition_supported = edition_supported && run . inputs . edition_supported ; # [cfg (test)] let bootstrap_valid = run . inputs . bootstrap_valid ; # [cfg (not (test))] let bootstrap_valid = true ; # [cfg (test)] let forced_cancelled = run . inputs . cancelled ; # [cfg (not (test))] let forced_cancelled = false ; # [cfg (test)] let forced_resource = run . inputs . failures . resource_exhausted ; # [cfg (not (test))] let forced_resource = false ; # [cfg (test)] let forced_failure = run . inputs . failures . start_failed ; # [cfg (not (test))] let forced_failure = false ; let failure = if ! edition_supported { Some ("EditionUnsupported") } else if ! bootstrap_valid { Some ("BootstrapInvalid") } else if forced_cancelled || run . cancelled . load (Ordering :: Acquire) { Some ("Cancelled") } else if Instant :: now () >= run . deadline || forced_resource { Some ("ResourceLimit") } else if forced_failure { Some ("StartFailed") } else { None } ; ControlStartResult { ready : failure . is_none () , edition : run . edition . clone () , failure : failure . map (str :: to_owned) , } }
review.item_premise: The one-start decision checks edition and the ordered supplied facts and constructs the closed result. Its private macro callsite inherits the byte-entry span; its reviewed body is pinned so a changed start path reopens the work-unit definition.
